newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products flat, fuel trades at $79.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products flat, fuel trades at $79.

text.p: NWE oil products started the day quietly and were little changed with activity muted by holidays in Germany, traders said.
High sulphur fuel oil traded at $79.00 a tonne fob Rotterdam, within Wednesday's trading range, but the market was relatively quiet with around 10,000 tonnes worth of bunker demand in view.

Gasoline was exceptionally quiet and few traders were aware of buy/sell levels. One dealer ventured that prices were probably little changed from Wednesday, considering that NYMEX futures did not move far after the close of European markets. This would place prices in the $204/$205 range.
Gas oil was also flat and no barges were heard to have been traded. "It is awful quiet," one Rotterdam-based trader said.
